text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am Air Messiah.
It is a pleasure to work with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My strength is being earnest and steadfast.
My weakness... is that that's all I have.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"However—I will definitely surpass them.
Through sheer effort, I will surpass everything."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
